Azure Resource Manager swagger subsets embedded under internal/azure/arm/models
(extracted by tools/azuremodels/extract.py from commit
8254fa29b6360b48084554122a7c49f6c4237d84; each model lists its source files and SHA-256).
Only specification JSON data is used; no Microsoft code, logo or SDK is embedded.
